LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.Smartstore.MultiSms
LocaleResource.Value: Switchable SMS gateway with Kavenegar and Melipayamak

LocaleResource.Name: Intro
LocaleResource.Value: Configure two independent SMS providers. Changes take effect on the next message without restarting. Failover occurs only on explicit rejection; ambiguous timeouts are never retried automatically.

LocaleResource.Name: SecretHint
LocaleResource.Value: Leave blank to keep the stored secret; use Clear to remove it. Credentials are encrypted in settings.

LocaleResource.Name: TestHint
LocaleResource.Value: Tests use SAVED settings, not unsubmitted form changes. An accepted response does not confirm handset delivery.

LocaleResource.Name: TestAccepted
LocaleResource.Value: Provider {0} accepted the SMS (message ID {1}). Delivery to the handset is not yet confirmed.

LocaleResource.Name: TestRejected
LocaleResource.Value: The SMS was not confirmed. Check your provider configuration and the application logs.
